turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero and tell me what else you have besides that checker, or I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here, Hale? Teams don't enter a zero first and call the parent a week later. What else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay to be withdrawn, an explanation of who decided it and on what basis, and confirmation that he was not heard before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed and the principal still on the table.
What moved her: nothing.
